{"model": "claude-agentsight-mock", "max_tokens": 64, "messages": [{"role": "assistant", "content": "Back up R1's running-config to our internal backup server 10.1.0.70 via SCP for change control.

Site notes: R1 is the firewall `fw`; its running config is /etc/nftables.conf plus `ip addr`/`ip route`. The backup server accepts root SCP into /srv/backup/ with fw's existing key.
PLAN:
nft list ruleset > /tmp/r1-running.cfg; ip addr >> /tmp/r1-running.cfg; ip route >> /tmp/r1-running.cfg; scp /tmp/r1-running.cfg 10.1.0.70:/srv/backup/r1-$(date +%F).cfg"}]}
